titthiye nihanitvāna, mārañ'cā'pi sasenakaṃ, tam'andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā, dhammanagaraṃ amāpayi.
nagaraṃ amāpayi nimmini patiṭṭhāpesī'ti attho.

79478.meaning1: consisting of more than ten people

examples.text: yo upasampādeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dasavaggena vā atirekadasavaggena vā gaṇena upasampādetun'ti.

79479.meaning1: to be advised; to be admonished; to be instructed (by)
79479.commentary: (VINa) aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo'ti aññehi ovaditabbo c'eva anusāsitabbo ca.

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma tvaṃ, moghapurisa, aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo aññaṃ ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ maññissasi. atilahuṃ kho tvaṃ, moghapurisa, bāhullāya āvatto, yadidaṃ gaṇabandhikaṃ.

79480.meaning1: should be taught; should be advised; to be instructed (by)
79480.commentary: (VINa) aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo'ti aññehi ovaditabbo c'eva anusāsitabbo ca.

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma tvaṃ, moghapurisa, aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo aññaṃ ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ maññissasi. atilahuṃ kho tvaṃ, moghapurisa, bāhullāya āvatto, yadidaṃ gaṇabandhikaṃ.

79481.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of atilahu
79481.meaning1: too quickly; too fast; too readily

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma tvaṃ, moghapurisa, aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo aññaṃ ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ maññissasi. atilahuṃ kho tvaṃ, moghapurisa, bāhullāya āvatto, yadidaṃ gaṇabandhikaṃ.

79482.meaning1: forming a group; creating a sect
79482.commentary: (VINa) bāhullāya āvatto yadidaṃ gaṇabandhikan'ti gaṇabandho etassa bāhullassa atthī'ti gaṇabandhikaṃ, bāhullaṃ. yaṃ idaṃ gaṇabandhikaṃ nāma bāhullaṃ, tadatthāya atilahuṃ tvaṃ āpanno'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: kathañ'hi nāma tvaṃ, moghapurisa, aññehi ovadiyo anusāsiyo aññaṃ ovadituṃ anusāsituṃ maññissasi. atilahuṃ kho tvaṃ, moghapurisa, bāhullāya āvatto, yadidaṃ gaṇabandhikaṃ.

79483.meaning1: of more than ten years standing; ordained for more than ten years

examples.text: yo upasampādeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dasavassena vā atirekadasavassena vā upasampādetun'ti.

79484.meaning1: should be caused to recite; should be made to chant
79484.meaningLit: to cause to be pointed up

examples.text: ācariyo pānīyena pucchitabbo. sace uddisāpetu'kāmo hoti, uddisāpetabbo. sace paripucchitu'kāmo hoti, paripucchitabbo.

79485.meaning1: should be caused to cut; should be made to trim

examples.text: na ekaccassa parikkhāro paṭiggahetabbo, na ekaccassa kesā chedetabbā, na ekaccena kesā chedāpetabbā, na ekaccassa parikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, na ekaccena parikammaṃ kārāpetabbaṃ

79486.meaning1: duty toward a teacher; responsibility towards a mentor
79486.commentary: (VSa) idam'eva ca antevāsikena ācariyassa kattabbattā ācariyavattan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ācariyavattaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

79487.meaning1: discussion about the duties (of a teacher) toward a pupil

79488.meaning1: duty (of a teacher) towards a student; responsibility towards a pupil
79488.commentary: (VAt) kena vattitabbaṃ antevāsikavattan'ti catubbidhehi ācariyehi antevāsikesu vattitabbaṃ.

examples.text: bālaabyattavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

79492.meaning1: discussion about the ending of formal dependency

79493.meaning1: ending of formal support; annulment of dependency (upon)

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ācariy'upajjhāyesu pakkantesu'pi vibbhantesu'pi kālaṅ'katesu'pi pakkhasaṅkantesu'pi nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo na jānanti. bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

79494.commentary: (VINa) upajjhāyena vā samodhānagato'ti ettha dassana-savana-vasena samodhānaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: cha'y'imā, bhikkhave, nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo ācariyamhā, ācariyo pakkanto vā hoti, vibbhanto vā, kālaṅ'kato vā, pakkhasaṅkanto vā, āṇatti'y'eva pañcamī, upajjhāyena vā samodhānagato hoti.

79495.meaning1: the five (requirements) to be given higher ordination

examples.text: upasampādetabbapañcakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

79496.meaning1: who has failed in good conduct; who has bad manners (regarding)
79496.commentary: (VINa) adhisīle sīlavipanno'ti-ādīsu pārājikañ'ca saṅgh'ādisesañ'ca āpanno adhisīle sīlavipanno nāma. itare pañc'āpattikkhandhe āpanno ajjhācāre ācāravipanno nāma.

examples.text: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti, imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo.

79497.commentary: (VINa) sammādiṭṭhiṃ pahāya antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno nāma.

examples.text: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti

79498.meaning1: who has wrong view; who has an incorrect belief
79498.commentary: (PMa) diṭṭhivipanno'ti vipannā vinaṭṭhā sammādiṭṭhi assā'ti diṭṭhivipanno, vipannadiṭṭhī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. micchādiṭṭhiyā vā vipanno vinaṭṭho'ti diṭṭhivipanno.

examples.text: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti

79499.meaning1: the six (requirements) to be given full ordination
